Basics

Liver spread

Májkrém

6 months+ Adjusted 25 min 1 portion

From 6 months, on soft vegetables, not on salty crackers. Do not serve liver dumplings or any other liver in the same week, and do not pair it with a vitamin A supplement.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 20 g raw chicken liver (about 15 g cooked; once in the week only)
  • 40 g eating apple (peeled and cooked soft)
  • 1 tsp rapeseed or olive oil (makes a thin spread)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Simmer the liver in water until fully cooked and no pink remains.
  2. Check the cooked liver for the child is about 15 g.
  3. Cook the apple until soft.
  4. Blend the liver, apple, and oil until the spread is thin.
  5. Cool quickly.
  6. Spread a thin layer on soft vegetables.

Adjusted

A salty liver spread on crackers ignores the vitamin A limit and adds salt.

Blend fully cooked chicken liver with apple and a little oil into a thin spread, with no salt. The child's share is about 15 g liver, at most once a week, and not alongside a vitamin A supplement.
